title: Drop deployment config
description: Everything specific to one Drop deployment except its secrets. See docs/design.md#deployment.

url.description: The deployment's public URL. Also the audience upload tokens must carry.

pages.description: The pages beyond Build pages: an index of Products at /, Product pages and Channel pages.

index.description: Set to false to turn off the index and Product pages. Channel and Build pages stay reachable by link.

owners.description: The GitHub accounts this deployment trusts. Within each, the repositories the deployment's GitHub App is installed on may upload. An empty list accepts nothing (ADR 0004). Run `npm run setup` after changing it.

repositories.description: Exceptions for single repositories, by owner/name. They never grant access: the repository must still belong to a listed Owner and be in the App's installation.

webhooks.description: Outgoing webhooks sent when a Build lands, by name. Each URL is the Worker secret WEBHOOK_<NAME>, upper-cased with dashes as underscores; a json webhook is signed with WEBHOOK_<NAME>_SECRET when set.

ownerName.description: A GitHub user or organization login.

repositoryException.description: pull_request_target and workflow_run run with the repository's permissions while handling fork content, so uploads from them are rejected unless allowed here.

channelPattern.description: A Channel name, or a prefix ending in * such as pr/*.

products.description: Application IDs to send for. Omit for every Product.

channels.description: Channel patterns to send for, such as main or pr/*; * is every Channel. Omit for the Product's default Channel only.

private.description: Makes a public repository's Product private. A private repository's Product cannot be made public (ADR 0010).

icon.description: An https URL of a square PNG used instead of the icon read from the APK.

commitComments.description: Set to false to stop announcing this Product's Builds outside pull requests with a comment on their commit.

retention.description: Overrides for docs/design.md#retention. The newest Build of every open Channel is always kept.
